content.short: MugglePay is a payment gateway that allows merchants to accept TON and other cryptos with low fees and no chargebacks.
content.description: MugglePay is a leading cryptocurrency payment gateway that empowers merchants to accept Toncoin and other digital assets as payment for goods and services. It provides a seamless checkout experience with low transaction fees, no chargebacks, and instant settlement. By integrating with the TON blockchain, MugglePay allows businesses to reach the massive Telegram user base and participate in the growing decentralized economy. Its easy-to-use APIs and plugins make it simple for any merchant to start accepting crypto payments in minutes.
content.meta: Accept Toncoin payments with MugglePay. Low fees and instant settlement, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
